text: Binary flag from the `argument` column (OP's own text, current supplied text including marked edits): 1 if the OP's wording contains at least one explicit polite apology phrase (e.g., sorry, I apologize, apologies for, my apologies, pardon me, excuse my), for any reason (length, formatting, wording, anything else); 0 if the argument is present with no such phrase. Do not count apologies in quotations attributed to others or quoted material the OP doesn't adopt, or non-apologetic "sorry" (e.g., "sorry state of affairs"). Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (including apologies or thanks within them); generic discussion of delta/platform rules stays eligible. Don't reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if the argument is missing or malformed.
